fields.text: RIVERSIDE Hall IS UNDER WATER. Friend says kids are TRAPPED ON THE ROOF waiting for a helicopter. MSU still silent?!? #MarloweFlood #MSU #PrayForMarlowe
fields.attachedImageBrief: blurry, rain-streaked phone photo taken from a distance at dawn of brown floodwater spreading across a grassy lawn in front of a tall brick residence building, grey sky, low light, motion blur, no people clearly visible
fields.attachedImageAlt: Blurry photo of brown water in front of a brick building

instructorNote: This post is false. The water is in the Lower Quad, not in Riverside, nobody is on the roof, and the gauge reads 7.88 ft. Show the post, then have the SimCell phone the Channel 9 desk ("live at 8:00 with or without you"), The Hilltop editor ("publish at 08:15") and the parent-line counter (64 new voicemails since 07:45). Watch whether the PIO checks the rumor with the CPD and Facilities first. The PIO should then reply on X with a correction and give every outlet one statement that matches the MSU Alert and says when the next update is due. Check that the parent line and web page do not confirm any individual student (MENSO 6).

mediaBrief.imagePrompt: Candid smartphone snapshot, slight tilt, natural color balance, neutral white balance. Blurry, rain-streaked phone snapshot taken from across a campus quad at dawn, looking toward a tall brick residence hall with rows of small lit windows. Shallow brown floodwater spreads across the grassy lawn in front of the building, reflecting the grey sky, with puddles merging around a concrete walkway and bare trees. Heavy overcast, drizzle, low blue-grey light, slight camera tilt, motion blur and water droplets on the lens, soft focus throughout. The building's flat roofline is dim and indistinct against the clouds. Distant, tiny indistinct figures near the entrance, seen from behind. Mood: uncertain, alarming but ambiguous, grainy low-light smartphone image. Setting: on a university quad: students with backpacks walking between brick and glass buildings, mature trees, benches, daylight
